**Testing project:** [platformer_gh_115738.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25376680/platformer_gh_115738.zip) Reproduction steps for the crash: - Run the project from the editor. - Switch to the Remote scene tree dock. Select the **Stage** node. - Assign some objects of any type to the 3 properties (I used InputEvent-derived types in my testing). Keep the **Stage** node selected afterwards. Your editor should look like this: - Wait around 30 seconds to a minute. The crash doesn't occur on `master`, but note the issue below that occurred in `master`. On the bright side, this PR seems to fix not being able to assign objects to properties while in the remote inspector. Previously, it would revert to `` shortly after you assign an object and print this: ``` ERROR: Resource file not found: res://::kujrx (expected type: unknown) at: _load (core/io/resource_loader.cpp:351) ```
LGTM. @Calinou, if you want to take another look.

Works great now 🙂 By the way, I'm thinking we should use a more compact representation for object IDs in a future PR. Right now, you need to make the inspector pretty wide to see the full value. We could for example switch to a hexadecimal representation, which should be shorter: ``` 9223372090726418139 <- decimal 8000000c8b0006db <- hexadecimal ``` There are probably ways to find an even shorter representation that can still be converted to the full ID (Base64?). **Edit:** Proposal opened: - https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/14433
